messages.author: Joanna Michelle Chua
messages.body:
Dear all,
I am buying a new laptop where I could run Amber 23. My old workstation uses RTX 2080Ti but its higher end counterparts - 3080/4080 and 3090/4090 are way outside my budget. I am considering to buy either am RTX 4060 or RTX 4070 (not the RTX 4070 Ti as listed in the website as GPUs where pmemd has been tested). Is there anyone using any of these GPUs? I would like to know about the pmemd performance in these GPUs. Thank you very much.
Joanna
Sent from Outlook for Android<
https://aka.ms/AAb9ysg
>
